posts.text: minst to nye oljetankere har gått på miner satt ut av Iran hittil idag Independent trackers confirm a sharp recent drop. Kpler and AIS data show 7-day Hormuz liquids clearances falling ~45-50% from early-November peaks (near 13-14 mb/d) to ~7-8 mb/d by mid-month, concurrent with elevated tanker incidents. UKMTO reported 7 tanker attacks in its latest weekly window; Iran claimed multiple mine strikes. October had the war’s highest monthly attack total, with November maintaining high pace. Bypass routes offset some overall Gulf volumes. 🚨 An extraordinary military scene in the Middle East. The United States is now massing 3 aircraft carriers and their strike groups in the region: 🔴 USS Theodore Roosevelt 🔴 USS George H.W. Bush 🔴 USS George Washington More than 20,000 sailors and Marines and hundreds of warplanes—the largest concentration of American aircraft carriers in the region since the Iraq War in 2003.
